binderUpdate.title: Your binder and your folders now stay in sync
binderUpdate.body1: Your binder now reads your folders directly, so the two can never fall out of step. You can organize your work here or in your computer's file explorer, and both will always match.
binderUpdate.body2: To do this, the first time you open an existing project it creates folders and moves your documents to match your old binder. Nothing is deleted, and none of your writing is changed.
binderUpdate.body3: If you preferred your earlier arrangement, you can put your folders back: open the command palette (press Ctrl+P, or Cmd+P on a Mac) and search for "Restore previous binder layout." A few empty folders the update created may remain; you can delete them.
